{"metadata":{"description":"Go SDK for driving DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1334710166","install_available":false,"language":"Go","name":"deepseek-harness-sdk-go","slug":"theoneLee/deepseek-harness-sdk-go","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-bundle","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-verify","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Go SDK for driving DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DeepSeek Harness Go SDK"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Go SDK for driving DeepSeek Harness. The SDK starts the Harness runtime as a
subprocess and speaks t"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"he line-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol over stdio. It
is a clean-room Go implementation of the prot"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ocol and mirrors the layering and
activity semantics of the upstream Python SDK."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Go 1.26 or newer.
- macOS arm64/x64, Linux amd64/arm64, or Windows amd64 when using the bundled
ru"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ntime downloader.
- An explicit `DSHHome` or non-empty `DSH_HOME` environment variable.
- A `DEEPSEE"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"K_API_KEY` environment variable, unless the selected profile uses
another credential path or a local"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"vironment variable, unless the selected profile uses
another credential path or a local model proxy."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The SDK targets the single-file runtime published by the DeepSeek Harness
project. With no explicit "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"executable, the first `Start` or `Run` resolves the
matching platform wheel from a PyPI-style index,"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" verifies SHA-256, extracts it
into a cache, and reuses it on later starts. The default target is ru"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ntime
`0.1.5-alpha.1`, corresponding to upstream tag `dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1`.
The matching public runti"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"me wheel must be available before automatic download
can start this version; use `DSHBin` or `Runtim"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"eIndexURL` when consuming a
private or pre-publication wheel."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`DeepSeekHarness` starts lazily and keeps the subprocess alive across runs.
Always call `Close` when"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" the harness is no longer needed so the runtime is
reaped promptly."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The runtime inherits the parent environment. `Env` overlays it for the child;
`BaseURL` and `APIKey`"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" are convenience fields for
`DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL` and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. `CWD` is sent in the initial"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ize
payload; `RuntimeCWD` controls the subprocess working directory. `DSHHome`
overrides the child `"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"DSH_HOME`; without it, the child must inherit a non-empty
`DSH_HOME`. `Profile` defaults to `sdk`, a"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"nd each `Patches` entry becomes an
absolute `--patch` argument. `ReasoningEffort` becomes `reasoning"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"Effort` in
initialize, while `MaxTokens == 0` omits `maxTokens`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The initialize handshake has its own 30-second default timeout through
`InitializeTimeoutSeconds`; `"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"RequestTimeoutSeconds` controls ordinary
requests."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Launch channels are resolved from most explicit to least explicit:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. `LaunchArgsOverride`.
2. `Command` with `Args`.
3. `DSHBin`.
4. `RuntimeBin` or `BridgeBin` (depr"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ecated compatibility aliases).
5. `DSH_RUNTIME_BIN` (deprecated compatibility override).
6. The bund"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"led runtime downloader."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"`DSHBin` and the bundled downloader append `--profile <Profile>` and ordered
`--patch <absolute path"},{"id":"p19s2","text":">` arguments, and require an explicit Harness home. The
new runtime has no downloaded default `cordi"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"s.yml`; its profile owns runtime
configuration. `LaunchArgsOverride` remains an internal-style escap"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"e hatch for
fake runtimes and bypasses the home check."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Sessions and results"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`Run` waits for the prompt's durable `agent/inbox/spliced` receipt, then
collects notifications unti"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"l the root session reaches its next `idle` state.
Notifications from known descendant sessions are i"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ncluded through
`subagent.started` lineage edges. `RunResult.Events` contains root-session
events on"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ly. `FinalResponse` is the last committed root assistant text in the
interval, and `FinishReason` is"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" the last `turn/end` reason kind when present.
Those values describe the owned activity interval, no"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"t an output causally
assigned to only the submitted prompt."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The callback is invoked for each collected notification after the inbox
receipt. `FinishReason` is a"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" `*string`; it is nil when no turn ended."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Low-level client"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`HarnessClient` exposes the protocol surface used by advanced integrations:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The client supports `Request`, `Notify`, `SessionPrompt`, `Subscribe`,
`SubscribeSessionTree`, `Next"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"Notification`, `NextRequest`, `Respond`, and
`RespondError`. Server-to-client requests are queued un"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"til the caller answers
them. Notifications that no subscription matched are available through
`NextN"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"r answers
them. Notifications that no subscription matched are available through
`NextNotification`."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Errors"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Errors are concrete types suitable for `errors.As`: `JsonRpcError`,
`RequestTimeoutError`, `Protocol"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"Error`, `TransportClosedError`,
`RuntimeResolveError`, and `IOError`. `TransportClosedError` include"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"s the
process exit code when available and the last 400 stderr lines."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"GitHub Actions runs formatting, vet, race-enabled tests, and the regular test
suite on Linux and mac"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"OS. Releases are created from matching `v*` tags; see
`docs/ROADMAP.md` for planned parity work.
For"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" the next upstream tag update, follow the tag update runbook."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Code Contribution Guide"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Area | Requirement |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| Scope | Keep changes focused on the Go SDK and its compatibility with the upstream Python SDK. |
|"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" Implementation | Follow existing package patterns, preserve raw protocol data, and add comments onl"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"y for non-obvious behavior. |
| Tests | Add or update mechanism tests for protocol, lifecycle, and r"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"untime-resolution changes. |
| Validation | Run `gofmt`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test -race ./...` b"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"efore opening a pull request. |
| Documentation | Update the relevant English and Chinese docs in `d"},{"id":"p35s6","text":"ocs/` when public behavior changes. |
| Pull request | Explain the behavior change, compatibility im"},{"id":"p35s7","text":"pact, and verification commands. Do not include API keys or runtime artifacts. |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The full contributor workflow, including branch, commit, and pull request
guidance, is in `docs/CONT"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ributor workflow, including branch, commit, and pull request
guidance, is in `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Relationship to DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"This repository owns the Go SDK. The runtime is published by the
DeepSeek Harness project as
`deepse"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"ek-harness-runtime-bin`. The SDK follows the documented
stdio JSON-RPC protocol
and tracks the Pytho"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"n SDK's public behavior as that implementation evolves."}],"truncated":false}
